request.text:
\Cref{ex:prop-metatheory-09} asks for the first two assertions of this
theorem: that logical equivalence of \(\mathsf{CPL}\) formulas is an
equivalence relation and a congruence for every primitive connective.  Its
feedback entry in \cref{app:exercise-feedback} is a solution sketch.  The
complete proof in Annex~\ref{annex:p2.prop.replacement} carries out the
cases that sketch names (negation and each binary connective), together with
the falsum case and the induction over the formula needed for replacement,
so a written solution can be checked against it clause by clause.
\Cref{thm:p02-uniform-substitution}, proved in
Annex~\ref{annex:p2.prop.substitution}, is the companion result for
simultaneous substitution of formulas for variables.
